name: Sensitive outpatient appointments audit line list
notes: This report shows an audit log of all modifications and cancellations to outpatient appointments at sensitive facilities. Each row represents a change event, showing both the current appointment details and the previous values before the change. The report is designed to track which Tamanu users are creating and editing appointments. Status-only changes (e.g., Confirmed to Arrived) are excluded unless the status change is to Cancelled. If an appointment is changed multiple times, each modification will appear as a separate line.
